source: Historical documentation seed, not a live Hermes Kanban export

tasks.task_text: Run the existing terminal target discovery probe in a normal visible Windows Terminal and record the current result.
applicable_constraints: Window handles and process IDs are ephemeral and must not become fixed settings.
This check must not allocate screenshot resources.
current_observations: A prior normal-user probe found a visible, non-minimized, uncloaked WindowsTerminal.exe candidate.
expected_validation: The output records whether a current visible terminal candidate is found.
The observation is not treated as proof of active-tab ownership or capture visibility.

tasks.task_text: Implement small native observer probes for input, lock, suspend, resume, and power-source observations.
prerequisite_state: Rust compilation, build-script execution, linking, and Win32 executable execution pass.
Windows API presence alone does not establish runtime behavior.
applicable_constraints: Change no power or locking settings.
Use documented executable and Cargo output locations under AppData\Local.
current_observations: API-presence checks exist as prior static observations.
Registration, device coverage, and a Rust event loop remain untested.
expected_validation: Observe real lock, suspend, resume, and power-source transitions.
Record unavailable observations as limits rather than healthy states.
Validate keyboard, external mouse, and touchpad coverage separately.

tasks.task_text: Run an explicitly invoked Windows Graphics Capture feasibility test against a live Windows Terminal target.
prerequisite_state: A current visible target must first be discovered.
The observer content must be displayed in the selected terminal target.
applicable_constraints: Screenshots are permitted only during this explicit test.
Ordinary tracking must not allocate capture resources.
A stable window handle does not prove observer content.
current_observations: No screenshot or capture session has run.
Capture support, active-tab ownership, observer visibility, and freshness are unknown.
expected_validation: Create capture for the selected window.
Verify a changing marker and image freshness.
Reject the initial image if observer visibility cannot be established.
Record resource use and any effect on normal idle behavior.

tasks.task_text: Compare tracking-only, test-mode baseline, and helper-enabled idle outcomes under matching known power conditions.
prerequisite_state: The observer must provide reliable required observations.
Capture behavior must be validated before screenshot evidence is used.
applicable_constraints: Do not combine intervals across AC and battery boundaries.
Document applications that can affect idle behavior.
Measure display, session, and power outcomes independently.
current_observations: A historical helper heartbeat and user report exist.
The controlled idle test beyond the ten-minute screen-saver timeout remains pending.
expected_validation: Run matching-condition baselines with and without the helper.
Complete the proposed thirty-minute idle target where applicable.
Report observation gaps and mixed conditions without claiming a pass.

tasks.task_text: Implement optional owned-child helper launching, graceful cleanup, and console signal routing.
prerequisite_state: Baseline and separately started manual-helper validation must be complete first.
applicable_constraints: Stopping an observer attached to an independently launched helper must not stop that helper.
current_observations: No Rust observer or owned-child path exists.
Owned-child cleanup is explicitly outside the current feasibility gate.
expected_validation: Establish graceful cleanup and console signal routing before enabling helper launching.
Verify behavior separately for attached and owned helper processes.
